x-fc-pending.title: Pending of the spec
x-fc-pending.description: Routes, fields and events the API in production already has but the snapshot in spec/funnelchat.json does not describe yet. scripts/generate.mjs adds them to the spec before generating the types, only while the snapshot lacks them: when a new snapshot brings them, generation uses the snapshot and lists the entries of this file that can be deleted.

rules.paths: An operation (method + path) is added only if the snapshot does not have it.
rules.operationPatches: A patch adds properties to the body of a snapshot operation only while that operation matches `while`.
rules.webhooks: An event is added if the snapshot does not have it, or replaces it while it matches `x-fc-replace-while`.
rules.responsePatches: A patch replaces the responses of a snapshot operation (every 2xx, and the other codes it brings) only while that operation matches `while`.
rules.components.schemas: The schemas of this layer start with `Pending` so they never clash with the snapshot's.
rules.schemaPatches: A patch adds properties to a snapshot schema, each one only while the schema lacks it.

PendingClientReference.description: Your reference to match the send with the history and with `message.status_changed`: 1 to 64 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. It is neither unique nor authenticated; do not put personal data in it.

campaign_ids.description: Only delivers the events of these campaigns. An event without a campaign does not pass the filter.

PendingWebhookSubscription.description: A unified webhook subscription. It never carries the secret.

id.description: Identifier of the subscription. Store it when you create it: it is what tells yours apart.

secret.description: The full secret to verify the signature. It is shown only once: store it.

url.description: `https`, public and without user or password.

events.description: Types of the catalog (`GET /api/v1/webhooks/events`). The key needs the `{area}:read` permission of the area of each type.

PendingWebhookSubscriptionDelivery.description: One delivery attempt. The attempts of the same event share `event_id`.

PendingWebhookSubscriptionTestResult.description: Result of the test delivery (`webhook.test`). It answers 200 even when your server fails: check `succeeded`.

PendingPublicMessage.description: A message as an API key sees it: always these ten keys. It is what a send answers and what `GET /api/v1/contacts/{contact}/messages/{message}` returns.

id.description: The id of the message in the history of the contact: the same `message_id` of `message.status_changed`.

type.description: The public type of the message (`text`, `image`, `contact`…), the same as in `message.received`.

status.description: A send just accepted is `queued` (accepted is not sent); then it moves to `sent`, `delivered`, `read` or `failed`. `null` when the message has no delivery status (received, note) or it is unknown.

PendingForwardResult.description: The result of a forward for one destination, with its message (`null` when nothing was registered for that destination).

PendingMessageError.description: Why it failed. When Funnelchat stopped it, `code` is `null` and `reason` says why; when it failed in WhatsApp, `code` and `title` are the provider's and `reason` is `null`.

PendingSendResult.description: The registered message: `status: queued` and its `id`, the same `message_id` of `message.status_changed`.

PendingFileType.description: The type of the file in `file`. Needed when the URL does not end in a known extension (a signed URL, or one without extension); when present, it wins over the extension. Without it, a URL without a known extension answers `422 errors.file_type` and an unsupported extension `415`.

PendingFileName.description: The name the document arrives with. With `file_type: document` and a URL without a known extension it is required and must have an extension (`422 errors.file_name`).

PendingFormNumber.description: A number where the form is published (or being published).

PendingForm.description: One version of a form. `id` is the version; `family_id` is the form itself: the `form_id` you send it with and the `form.id` of `whatsapp_form.completed`.

name.description: The name in Meta (with the `__vN` suffix).

definition.description: The definition of the form (screens and fields). Only in the detail.

draft_id.description: Only in the list: the draft of the family, when it is not this row.

get.description: A message by the `id` a send or a webhook gave you (`message_id` of `message.status_changed`). Accepted is not delivered: `status` moves from `queued` to `sent`, `delivered`, `read` or `failed`.

404.description: The message does not exist or is not of that contact.

get.description: Every subscription of the account (50 at most), also the ones other integrations created. Account owner only.

post.description: Returns the `secret` only once. Cap: 50 subscriptions per account (the next one answers 422).

422.description: URL rejected, invalid event types or cap reached

get.description: It does not carry the secret. If you lost it, rotate it.

put.description: Replaces `url`, `events`, `description` and `filters`; `status` is optional (`active` or `paused`). The secret stays.

delete.description: Deletes the subscription with its delivery history.

post.description:
A new secret, shown only once; the previous one stops working.

**Not open to API keys:** with a key it answers `403 route_not_available`. Rotate the secret from the panel.
One signed delivery of `webhook.test`, without retries. It stays in the history.

get.description: One row per attempt, newest first. Paginate with `page` and `per_page` (25 by default, 100 at most).

definition.description: Screens and fields of the form.

expected_updated_at.description: The `updated_at` you read: if it changed since then, it answers `409 STALE`.

204.description: Deleted. A published version answers `409 PUBLISHED`.

post.summary: Send a form to a contact
post.description: Sends a form published on the number. It is a send: it follows the WhatsApp rules (24-hour window, pace, anti-spam limits) and answers the queued message. Errors of its own: `404 form_not_found`, `422 form_not_published`, `422 form_not_on_number`, `422 number_not_eligible`, `422 recipient_unreachable`.

text.description: The text of the message. By default, the name of the form.

button_text.description: The text of the button, without emojis. By default "Abrir" (or "Open").

200.description: The form was registered as a message (`type: whatsapp_form`, `status: queued`).

is_coexistence.description: The number uses the WhatsApp Business app and the Cloud API at the same time.

capabilities.description: What the number can do through the API, by provider (QR or WhatsApp Cloud) and what your account has enabled. Check it before offering a feature: a send the number does not support answers `422 provider_unsupported`.

statuses.description: The statuses `message.status_changed` reports for the messages of this number.

200.description: The message was registered (`status: queued`) and goes out from the queue.

415.description: The extension of the file is not supported and no `file_type` was sent.

200.description: One message per card, in the order of `contact_card_ids`: `queued`, or `failed` (`not_queued`) when it could not be queued.
One item per destination, in the order asked, each with its `message` (or `null`: queued but not registered yet, blocked, or it could not be read).
The message was registered (`status: queued`) and goes out from the queue.

415.description: The extension of the file is not supported and no `file_type` was sent.

200.description: The template was registered as a message (`status: queued`).

422.description: `template_unresolved_placeholder`: a variable points to a field that does not exist (`placeholders`, up to 20, and `count`); `recipient_mismatch`; or a send rule.

post.description: The delivery status of a message you sent with the API changed. One notice per transition, never one that goes back; `queued` is not reported. It must be asked for explicitly in `events`.

message_id.description: The `id` of the message in the history of the contact.

device_id.description: The number of your account that sent the message.

client_reference.description: The `client_reference` you sent with the message, or `null`.
